The Widower's Nest is recommended for levels 20 to 40, It is the fifth dungeon in the normal sequence, proceeding from Vegrim's Vexation. It is accessible through The Widower's Nest Base Camp.

DUNGEON DETAILS

Level 1

Elm Forest Layout. Contains Toxic Shaman, Poison Whiskers, Noxious Venomspitters, Divine Devastator!s and Divine Fade Generals.

There are two NPC's here; Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk who gives several quests and Fiery Pygmy Tracks, which lead to Fiery Pygmys and their leader (who all bear a similarity to Mutant Hulks except being smaller). Sometimes you will encounter the Gnome Gatekeeper and killing him gives access to the Bonus Stage.

Ruins of Castle Caninenstein is located off Level 1.

Ruins of Castle Caninenstein

Ruins Layout (DUH). Contains Ember Devastators!, Bone Collectors and Fade Lichlords as well as Toxic Raythes and Haunts. Sometimes from here you can reach the Bonus Stage by killing the Gnome Gatekeeper. Fiery Pygmy Tracks can also be found here.

Level 2

Elm Forest Layout. Contains Toxic Shaman, Poison Whiskers, Noxious Venomspitters, Divine Devastator!s and Divine Fade Generals.

Level 3

Elm Forest Layout. Contains Poison Whiskers, Forest Blademasters, Noxious Venomspitters, Divine Devastator!s and Divine Fade Generals.

Maerz Catacombs of Doom is located off Level 3.

Maerz Catacombs of Doom

Catacombs Layout. Contains Bone Collectors, Ember Devastator!s, Toxic Haunts, Toxic Raythes and Toxic Manglers. If you have taken the proper quest, the Expectant Hatchling can sometimes be found here too.

Level 4

Elm Forest Layout.Contains Poison Whiskers, Forest Blademasters, Noxious Venomspitters, Divine Devastator!s and Divine Fade Generals.

Return to the Ruins of Castle Caninenstein is located off Level 4.

Return to the Ruins of Castle Caninenstein

Ruins Layout (triple DUH!). Contains Bone Collectors, Toxic Haunts, Ember Devastator!s, Toxic Raythes and Toxic Manglers.

Level 5

Crypt Layout. Contains Bone Collectors, Ember Devastator!s, Toxic Haunts, Toxic Raythes, Toxic Manglers and Hatchling Scouts. There are many doors to open. You will see an occasional Sarcophagus (stone coffin) and a few of them contain some low level treasures. Suggested resistances Fire and Poison.

Dug's Digsite and Frump's Interdungeonal Resort are located off Level 5. There is an NPC here called Sir Tified Luhny. This is a small and relatively easy dungeon to run at high difficulty. From here you may sometimes reach the Bonus Stage (reached only by killing the Gnome Gatekeeper).

Dug's Digsite

Cave Layout. Contains Frozen Orok Slayers, Frigid Orok Runts, Toxic Mutant Pincers, Toxic Mutant Unipsychos and Toxic Mutant Pukers.

From here you may sometimes reach the Bonus Stage (reached only by killing the Gnome Gatekeeper).

Level 6

Crypt Layout. Contains Bone Collectors, Toxic Haunts, Ember Devastator!s, Toxic Raythes, Toxic Manglers, Hatchling Scouts and Chaos Fade Generals.

Level 7

Crypt Layout. Contains Bone Collectors, Toxic Haunts, Ember Devastator!s, Toxic Raythes, Toxic Manglers, Hatchling Scouts and Chaos Fade Generals.

Tomb of the Ice Climber, Xelhduh's Hideout and Widow Maker's Lair are located off Level 7

Tomb of the Ice Climber

It is not ice but uses the Cave Layout. Contains Frozen Orok Slayers, Orok Mystics, Frigid Orok Runts, Toxic Mutant Pincers and Toxic Mutant Pukers.

Xelhduh's Hideout

Cave Layout. Contains Frozen Orok Slayers, Frigid Orok Runts, Orok Mystics, Toxic Mutant Pincers and Toxic Mutant Pukers.

Widow Maker's Lair

Widow Maker, Boss of The Widower's Nest

You will find the Widow Maker here.

The first room you enter is full of Bone Collectors and Hatchlings who will swarm all over you. An area spell is very necessary here as it would be essentially impossible to deal with them all one by one. Once you have eliminated all of them, you will find a fiery barrier blocking your way.

In each corner of the first room is a Fade Generator. You must destroy each Fade Generator in succession. You will get a message "The barrier is weakened" and Bone Collectors will begin coming out of the floor each time you destroy a machine. Deal with each batch, and after all the Fade Generators and their creations are destroyed the barrier will disappear.

This will grant you access to Widow Maker's actual lair. The Widow Maker is a giant Black Widow Spider who has the ability to generate groups of Hatchlings. When she and her broods are finally destroyed, the Boss Gate will open to four treasure chests and the portal to Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

For tips on fighting The Widow Maker, see the Widow Maker Boss Guide.
